## Describe the bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Command executed
```bash
cinch init ...
```

## Expected behavior
What native file(s) or frontmatter structure should have been created according to vendor specs?

## Actual behavior
What was actually written or what error occurred?

## Environment
- OS: [e.g. macOS 14.5, Ubuntu 22.04]
- Python version: [e.g. 3.12]
- Cinch version: [e.g. 0.1.0]
